summary: Risk sentiment is broadly defensive today: technology and AI-linked equities are under pressure, while oil is sharply higher on renewed supply and geopolitical concerns.[2][3][5] Bitcoin and Ether are also lower, whereas gold is finding modest support from a weaker dollar but remains on track for a small weekly decline.[1][2]
